name: batch_exports_runs_list
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/batch_exports/{batch_export_id}/runs/
batch_exports_runs_list
Required: batch_export_id (path); project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: after (query) — Only return runs created at or after this point. Accepts an ISO-8601 datetime or a relative value like `-7d`. Defaults to `-7d`. Ignored when ordering by `data_interval_start`.; before (query) — Only return runs created at or before this point. Accepts an ISO-8601 datetime or a relative value like `-1d`. Defaults to now. Ignored when ordering by `data_interval_start`.; cursor (query) — The pagination cursor value.; end (query) — Only return runs whose data interval ends at or before this point. Accepts an ISO-8601 datetime or a relative value like `-1d`. Defaults to now. Only applies when ordering by `data_interval_start`.; ordering (query) — Which field to use when ordering the results.; start (query) — Only return runs whose data interval starts at or after this point. Accepts an ISO-8601 datetime or a relative value like `-7d`. Defaults to `-7d`. Only applies when ordering by `data_interval_start`.; status (query) — Only return runs in these statuses. Repeat the parameter to pass more than one status.
